title: Acme Corp Web & API VAPT Program

sections.heading: Program Background
sections.body:
Acme Corporation operates three customer-facing web portals and a partner API gateway.
All portals handle cardholder data during checkout and must remain PCI compliant.

sections.heading: Scope of Testing
sections.body:
The vendor shall test all web applications and APIs listed in Annex A.
Annex A will be shared after contract signature and may be updated by the business at any time without change of fee.

sections.heading: Web Application Testing Requirements
sections.body:
Testing shall follow OWASP Top 10 and PTES methodology.
The vendor shall re-test findings until all issues are closed, for as long as the client requires, at no additional cost.

sections.heading: API Testing Requirements
sections.body: The partner API gateway shall be tested for authentication flaws, broken object level authorization and rate limiting gaps.

sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
sections.body:
Deliverables will be reviewed by the client security team and accepted when the client considers the work satisfactory.
No quantitative acceptance thresholds are defined in this tender.

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.body:
Testing windows must complete within 30 calendar days of purchase order issuance.
Re-tests must commence within 48 hours of report delivery.
